summary: Lemhi County R-6 cab built in 1958 to replace a 1917 log cabin; the register lists it, and sources report summer staffing.

access.note: Summer-staffed lookout on Salmon-Challis National Forest. Sources do not say whether visitors may enter the cab.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts tags it Drive-Up. The Forest Service describes a 2.6-mile Stein Mountain trail from Trail #6134 to the lookout. The sources describe the approach differently.

events.note: Log cabin lookout on the site, per the register and firelookout.com.
L-4 cab on a log crib replaced the cabin, per firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts. The sources give only the decade (1930s), so 1930 marks its start.
Current R-6 cab and carport. The register says it replaced the 1917 cabin and does not mention the 1930s cab.
Mr. and Mrs. Gene Mullikin listed as known staff for 2001-2002.

corrections.why: 3.0 m matches the 10-foot concrete base that firelookout.com describes. It is not the height of the tower or the cab, and no source gives a total height.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the 1958 cab replaced a 1917 log cabin. Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts add an L-4 cab on a log crib in the 1930s between them. The record keeps the fuller sequence and cites the register for 1917 and 1958.
Idaho Fire Lookouts tags the lookout Drive-Up. The Forest Service describes a 2.6-mile trail that ends at it. The record reports both and does not choose between them.

notes_for_editor: Brief height_m 3.0 is the 10-ft concrete base, not a height; removed. Brief design R-6 is supported. Summer staffing is undated. The 2001-2002 Mullikin entry is the only named staff. Forest name: register says Salmon-Challis, the other two say Salmon National Forest. Current condition and access are not confirmed by a recent source. No fire or rental record found. No photo URLs captured.
